## SCHOLARLY + DS&A CONTEXT
# ALGORITHM: IRT 3PL item selection (Fisher information maximization)
#   source:      journey-os-algorithms-scholarly.html §III · IRT specification
#   complexity:  O(n) selection per item (scan all candidates, pick max info)
#   parameters:  a=1.0 (discrimination, uncalibrated default), b=0.0 (difficulty, uncalibrated default), c=0.20 (guessing)
#   security:    N/A
#   invariants:
#     - Session size constrained to [5, 50] items
#     - EAP theta estimation uses 41 quadrature points on [-4, +4]
#     - Items never repeated within a session
#     - Fisher information I(theta) = a^2 * (P - c)^2 / ((1-c)^2 * P * (1-P))
#       where P = c + (1-c) / (1 + exp(-a*(theta-b)))
#
# FOUNDATION: Birnbaum, 1968
#   claim:   3PL model accounts for discrimination, difficulty, and guessing
#   rule:    Use uncalibrated defaults (a=1.0, b=0.0, c=0.20) until E08-S09 calibrates
#   applies: features/mastery-tracking/services/PracticeSessionService.ts
#
# DATA STRUCTURE: EAP theta estimation
#   source:  journey-os-algorithms-scholarly.html §III
#   ops:     41-point Gaussian quadrature, O(41) per theta estimate
#   where:   PracticeSessionService.estimateTheta()

## Summary
Build the practice session builder that selects items using IRT 3PL Fisher information maximization to create adaptive practice sessions of 5-50 items tailored to the student's current ability level.

## User story
As a student, I want to practice with items specifically targeted at my ability level, so that I efficiently learn concepts at the frontier of my knowledge.

## Why this matters
Random item selection wastes student time — too-easy items bore, too-hard items frustrate. IRT-based selection maximizes information gain per item, making each practice minute count. This is the core adaptive engine of the platform.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /api/practice/session creates a practice session with IRT-selected items
- [ ] Session size configurable between 5-50 items (default 20)
- [ ] Items selected by maximizing Fisher information at student's current EAP theta
- [ ] EAP theta estimated using 41 quadrature points on [-4, +4]
- [ ] Uncalibrated items use defaults: a=1.0, b=0.0, c=0.20
- [ ] Items never repeated within a single session
- [ ] Optional filters: usmle_system, concept_id, bloom_level
- [ ] PracticeBuilder UI shows session configuration + "Start Practice" button
- [ ] Practice session record created in Supabase with session metadata
- [ ] IRT engine is a pure function module with unit-testable math

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.practice_sessions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  student_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
  session_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (session_type IN ('adaptive', 'drill', 'study_queue')),
  item_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (item_count BETWEEN 5 AND 50),
  theta_estimate DOUBLE PRECISION,
  filters JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed', 'abandoned')),
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.practice_session_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.practice_sessions(id),
  item_id UUID NOT NULL,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  fisher_info DOUBLE PRECISION,
  answered BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  is_correct BOOLEAN,
  answered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  UNIQUE(session_id, position)
);

ALTER TABLE public.practice_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Students can read own sessions"
  ON public.practice_sessions FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() = student_id);
CREATE POLICY "Students can create own sessions"
  ON public.practice_sessions FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = student_id);

ALTER TABLE public.practice_session_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Students can read own session items"
  ON public.practice_session_items FOR SELECT
  USING (session_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.practice_sessions WHERE student_id = auth.uid()));

-- After adding: pnpm db:types to regenerate database.generated.ts
```

## API contract
```
POST /app/api/practice/session
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: {
  item_count: number,       // 5-50, default 20
  filters?: {
    usmle_system?: string,
    concept_id?: string,
    bloom_level?: string
  }
}
Response 200: {
  data: {
    session_id: string,
    theta_estimate: number,
    items: [
      { item_id: string, position: number, fisher_info: number }
    ],
    item_count: number,
    session_type: "adaptive"
  },
  error: null
}
Response 400: { data: null, error: { code: 'INVALID_COUNT', message: 'Item count must be between 5 and 50' } }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/mastery-tracking/services/IrtEngine.ts
export const IRT_DEFAULTS = {
  a: 1.0,   // discrimination (uncalibrated)
  b: 0.0,   // difficulty (uncalibrated)
  c: 0.20,  // guessing parameter
} as const;

const QUADRATURE_POINTS = 41;
const THETA_RANGE: [number, number] = [-4, 4];

/** IRT 3PL probability of correct response */
export function irt3PL(theta: number, a: number, b: number, c: number): number {
  return c + (1 - c) / (1 + Math.exp(-a * (theta - b)));
}

/** Fisher information at theta for item with parameters (a, b, c) */
export function fisherInfo(theta: number, a: number, b: number, c: number): number {
  const P = irt3PL(theta, a, b, c);
  const Q = 1 - P;
  if (P <= c || Q <= 0) return 0; // guard against division by zero
  return (a * a * Math.pow(P - c, 2)) / (Math.pow(1 - c, 2) * P * Q);
}

/** EAP theta estimation using 41-point quadrature */
export function estimateTheta(
  responses: Array<{ a: number; b: number; c: number; correct: boolean }>
): number {
  const step = (THETA_RANGE[1] - THETA_RANGE[0]) / (QUADRATURE_POINTS - 1);
  let numerator = 0;
  let denominator = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < QUADRATURE_POINTS; i++) {
    const theta = THETA_RANGE[0] + i * step;
    let likelihood = 1;
    for (const r of responses) {
      const p = irt3PL(theta, r.a, r.b, r.c);
      likelihood *= r.correct ? p : (1 - p);
    }
    // Standard normal prior
    const prior = Math.exp(-0.5 * theta * theta);
    const posterior = likelihood * prior;
    numerator += theta * posterior;
    denominator += posterior;
  }

  return denominator > 0 ? numerator / denominator : 0;
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ Random item selection
const items = allItems.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, count); // BANNED
// ✓ Use: IRT Fisher information maximization

// ✗ Items without three-hub connection
const eligible = items.filter(i => i.concept_id); // Missing SLO + USMLE check
// ✓ Use: items that connect SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic

// ✗ Hardcoded session size without bounds
const session = createSession({ item_count: requestedCount }); // No bounds check
// ✓ Use: Math.max(5, Math.min(50, requestedCount))
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S05.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { irt3PL, fisherInfo, estimateTheta } from '../../features/mastery-tracking/services/IrtEngine';

test('IRT 3PL: probability at theta=b equals (1+c)/2', () => {
  const p = irt3PL(0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.20);
  expect(p).toBeCloseTo(0.60, 2); // (1 + 0.20) / 2 = 0.60
});

test('IRT 3PL: probability is clamped between c and 1', () => {
  const pLow = irt3PL(-10, 1.0, 0.0, 0.20);
  const pHigh = irt3PL(10, 1.0, 0.0, 0.20);
  expect(pLow).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.20);
  expect(pHigh).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1.0);
});

test('Fisher information peaks near item difficulty', () => {
  const infoAtB = fisherInfo(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.20);
  const infoFarFromB = fisherInfo(3.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.20);
  expect(infoAtB).toBeGreaterThan(infoFarFromB);
});

test('EAP theta: all correct responses -> positive theta', () => {
  const responses = Array(5).fill({ a: 1.0, b: 0.0, c: 0.20, correct: true });
  const theta = estimateTheta(responses);
  expect(theta).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('EAP theta: all incorrect responses -> negative theta', () => {
  const responses = Array(5).fill({ a: 1.0, b: 0.0, c: 0.20, correct: false });
  const theta = estimateTheta(responses);
  expect(theta).toBeLessThan(0);
});

test('POST /api/practice/session returns 400 for invalid item count', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.post('/api/practice/session', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { item_count: 100 }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400);
});

test('POST /api/practice/session creates adaptive session', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.post('/api/practice/session', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { item_count: 10 }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.session_id).toBeTruthy();
  expect(data.items.length).toBe(10);
  expect(data.session_type).toBe('adaptive');
});

// tests/E08/E08-S05.ui.test.ts
test('Practice builder renders session configuration form', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudent(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /start practice/i }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="practice-builder"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByLabel(/number of items/i)).toBeVisible();
});
```
